# Australian Indian Orchestra

> The Australian Indian Orchestra (AIO) is a Sydney-based orchestra performing Indian classical, Bollywood film and fusion music with symphonic arrangements.

The website provides information about AIO, its concerts and services, performance videos, a photo gallery, and a blog. Concert listings and blog posts may be supplied by the connected WordPress service and can change over time.

## About
- [About AIO](https://aio.org.au/about): Orchestra story, founders and mission
- [Join AIO](https://aio.org.au/join): Auditions, volunteer roles and updates
- [Contact](https://aio.org.au/contact): Enquiries and booking requests

## Concerts
- [The Music of A.R. Rahman in Symphony](https://aio.org.au/concert/a-r-rahman-in-symphony): Symphonic performances of music by A.R. Rahman
- [Chorus Mandala](https://aio.org.au/concert/chorus-mandala): Concert archive for the choir and chamber orchestra programme
- [Symphony of Lights](https://aio.org.au/concert/symphony-of-lights): Past Bollywood and Indian fusion concert
- [Sydney to Mumbai](https://aio.org.au/concert/sydney-to-mumbai): Past programme connecting Australian and Indian music
- [Indian String Sensations](https://aio.org.au/concert/strings-sensations): AIO debut concert programme
- [A Musical Welcome to the Prime Minister](https://aio.org.au/concert/welcome-pm-narendra-modi): Performance archive
- [Upcoming concerts and tour updates](https://aio.org.au/tour): Current event listings and tour registration
